source.historicalSemanticScan: docs/**/*.json with candidate, review, or index in basename

reviewLedger.auth: unverified; registry metadata does not close authentication, retention, or billing terms
reviewLedger.sideEffects: paid remote AI execution; tool permissions and data handling are not closed
reviewLedger.reason: Reverse-DNS namespace and remote URL exist, but no publisher repository, service license, authentication contract, privacy terms, tool permissions, or billing boundary was closed.

reviewLedger.license: mixed MIT/Apache-2.0/BUSL-1.1; remote service license unverified
reviewLedger.auth: remote service authentication and data policy are not closed
reviewLedger.sideEffects: the repository is a broader authority platform and does not prove the docs remote-service tool boundary
reviewLedger.reason: Publisher control is credible, but the mixed repository license is not a blanket remote-service license and the remote tool, authentication, commercial-production, and data boundaries remain unresolved.

reviewLedger.sideEffects: name availability, pricing, records, and possible chain transaction boundary are not closed
reviewLedger.reason: The publisher-controlled domain is established, but license, authentication, exact tools, signing or transaction behavior, network, and fee boundaries are not proven.

reviewLedger.license: MIT documentation only; private server and content excluded
reviewLedger.auth: publisher documentation claims no authentication; remote service was not invoked
reviewLedger.sideEffects: goji_start_enquiry sends a real email to a staffed inbox
reviewLedger.reason: The private server is outside the documentation license and one tool has an external email side effect, so a generic link-only card would still lack a closed service and consent contract.

reviewLedger.auth: data transfer and service authentication are not closed
reviewLedger.sideEffects: regulated-health compliance output may be mistaken for legal or regulatory advice
reviewLedger.reason: The package version and license are visible, but no source repository, fixed source review, ruleset provenance, data handling, authentication, or regulated-advice disclaimer contract is closed.

reviewLedger.license: NOASSERTION at repository level; pinned subdirectory license not closed
reviewLedger.sideEffects: reads and writes a persistent SQLite database volume
reviewLedger.reason: Docker labels the entry Archived and its upstream is a reference server; it must not be presented as a current production resource even as link-only discovery.

reviewLedger.sideEffects: accesses Airtable schemas and records; exact write scope is not closed
reviewLedger.reason: This third-party local API-key implementation is not the active7 Airtable official remote OAuth server; the shared product/name cannot be merged or used to overwrite the official resource.

reviewLedger.sideEffects: dynamic tools and vessel-location data privacy or billing are not closed
reviewLedger.reason: The Docker entry supplies only an unversioned SSE remote URL with dynamic tools and no repository, license, authentication, privacy, pricing, or stable publisher documentation.

reviewLedger.auth: mounts host Azure account material and kubeconfig
reviewLedger.sideEffects: supports readonly, readwrite, and admin levels; unspecified namespaces allow all namespaces
reviewLedger.reason: First-party repository and license are closed, but host credential mounts, cluster-wide namespace scope, and readwrite/admin infrastructure effects require a separate high-risk profile review.

reviewLedger.auth: manifest exposes arbitrary ALFRESCO_HOST but does not close authentication
reviewLedger.sideEffects: document-management permissions are not enumerated; image namespace differs from publisher
reviewLedger.reason: The upstream explicitly calls the server experimental, while image publisher authorization, image digest or signature, authentication, and exact document permissions are unresolved.

reviewLedger.auth: database password and Alibaba Cloud AK/SK secrets
reviewLedger.sideEffects: network insecure_allow_all and optional unrestricted SQL write tools
reviewLedger.reason: ToolHive's Official tier is not author identity; its catalog and OCI versions disagree, and allow-all networking plus credential and unrestricted SQL write modes prevent a safe proposal.

reviewLedger.sideEffects: extracts data from arbitrary public URLs; robots, terms, and privacy policy are not fixed
reviewLedger.reason: ToolHive is the image builder rather than original author, catalog and image versions disagree, and URL policy, data handling, secret, and site-compliance boundaries are unresolved.

reviewLedger.auth: Apollo graph reference and APOLLO_KEY secret
reviewLedger.sideEffects: network insecure_allow_all and GraphQL mutations may write arbitrary graph data
reviewLedger.reason: The publisher image and repository are credible, but catalog and image versions disagree and no read-only operation allowlist or bounded network and mutation contract is present.

reviewLedger.auth: requires Astra application secret and API base URL
reviewLedger.sideEffects: network insecure_allow_all plus create, update, delete, and bulk-delete database tools
reviewLedger.reason: ToolHive builds the image rather than being the original author, catalog and OCI versions disagree, and database write/delete, secret, remote URL, and network scopes are not safe for proposal.

reviewLedger.auth: OAuth 2.1 using the user's Atlassian permissions
reviewLedger.sideEffects: creates and edits Jira issues, transitions issues, and creates or updates Confluence pages and comments
reviewLedger.reason: Publisher, product, and rolling remote service match active7 atlassian-rovo-mcp-server; ToolHive may be retained only as discovery provenance, not as a second Resource.
